test_deferred_message_init: test that DeferredMessage stores message type, args, and kwargs without building the message yet
test_deferred_message_build_regular: test that DeferredMessage.build_message constructs a regular Message instance from stored args and kwargs
test_deferred_message_build_timestamped: test that DeferredMessage.build_message constructs a TimestampedMessage with the current time as the first arg
test_event_init: test that Event wraps a DeferredMessage with a Topic and default delay and duration of zero
test_event_graph_accumulated_time: test that EventGraph manages events in a heap ordered by accumulated time with parent-child relationships
